import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    res = True
    while m > 0:
        rem = m % w
        if rem == 0 or rem == 1:
            m //= w
            continue
        if rem == w - 1:
            m += 1
            continue
        res = False
        break
    print("YES" if res else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
